title: Grateful Dead Live at Cameron Indoor Stadium, Duke U on 1973-12-08
lineage: SBD:MR> C> DAT> CD> EAC> SHN

ai_review.summary: Soundboard recording with solid clarity captures a mixed‑quality 1973 show highlighted by soaring China>Rider, an epic Other One and guest synth work, though the first half feels subdued.
ai_review.review: The SB tape is generally clear and well‑balanced, though a few listeners note slightly lower volume that may have been normalized. Musically the concert swings between moments of brilliance – a loose China > Rider, a fiery BE Woman/Big River stretch, a long, synth‑enhanced Other One and an inspired Outer Limits jam – and more muted stretches, especially early in the first set where the band sounds subdued and the main jam after He's Gone falls short for some fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Seven reviews give an average of ~3.4 stars; strong positive notes on recording quality and several standout songs lift the rating, while notable criticisms keep it from higher marks.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Clear soundboard source with crisp overall balance. Some listeners mention a slightly lower volume/possible normalization but no major drop‑outs or distortion.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set starts a bit subdued, picking up with strong numbers like BE Woman and Big River; the second set launches into spacey improvisation after He's Gone, building to an epic Other One and a synth‑laden Outer Limits before closing with heartfelt Wharf Rat and Uncle John's Band.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Delivers a fine BE Woman solo and meanders later in the set; strong presence on the extended jams.
band_member_comments.Keys: Ned Lagin joins on synth during the Outer Limits section, adding an effective texture praised by some listeners.
